Home.metaTitle: Bridge of Hearts | Find Children's Homes in Sri Lanka
Home.metaDescription: Welcome to Bridge of Hearts, an online directory for Child Development Centres (Children's Homes) in Sri Lanka.
Home.subheading: An online directory for Child Development Centres in Sri Lanka.
Home.p1: Every child deserves love, care, and a chance for a brighter future. Yet, in Sri Lanka, more than 10,000 children live in over 370 Child Development Centres commonly known as children's homes seeking stability and support.
Home.p2: At Bridge of Hearts, we believe in the power of connection. Our mission is to provide a trusted, up-to-date resource that shines a light on these homes, making it easier for donors to find and support the children who need it most.
Home.p3: With most child care facilities relying on external donations, your generosity can make a life-changing impact. Whether you give, volunteer, or spread the word you become part of a movement that bridges hearts and strengthens communities.
Home.p4: Together, let's bring hope, one child at a time.
Home.stat1: There are more than 370 child care facilities in Sri Lanka
Home.stat2: 60% of child care facilities run on external donations
Home.stat3: 71% of the children are between ages 5-14
Home.heroAlt: Three children smiling happily at the camera
Home.aerialAlt: An aerial view of a children's home, with a playground in front of it, where children are playing
Home.donationsAlt: Three boxes of donations, with clothes, food and stationery supplies
Home.uniformsAlt: Children in school uniforms smiling at the camera

About.heading: About Us
About.p1: Bridge of Hearts is a volunteer-driven initiative dedicated to creating a brighter future for children in Sri Lanka. Our platform connects donors with children's homes across the island, ensuring that donations and resources are distributed equitably to the places that need them the most.
About.p2: We started this project with a simple vision: to bridge the gap between generosity and need. By providing a transparent and comprehensive directory of children's homes, we aim to empower donors to make informed decisions and support the facilities that are often overlooked.
About.p3: It is our intention to continuously expand our reach by adding new children's homes to the directory. Soon, we will have information on all 370+ facilities across the island, ensuring that no home, big or small, is left behind.
About.p4: Together, we're working to change the landscape of child care donations in Sri Lanka. While the most well-known facilities receive the majority of support, our platform ensures that every child—no matter where they live—has the opportunity to thrive. We are actively expanding our reach to include data from all 9 provinces, starting with the Western and Central Provinces, so that no child is left behind.

Contact.heading: Contact Us
Contact.intro: We'd love to hear from you! If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to reach out to us.
Contact.help: If you have up-to-date information about any children's home listed on our website or know of a facility that should be included, please let us know. Your contributions help us keep our directory accurate and helps future donors find the information they need to support the children.
